<!--
Helper .qmd file that is called in index.qmd with a package name as input
and produces the same layout and output types for all tabs.
-->

```{r}
# Every metric that has a time series. 
series <- package_time_series(pkg)

# Those don't have an associated time series.
open_issues <- latest_open_issues(pkg)
open_prs <- latest_open_prs(pkg)
cov_by_file <- latest_coverage_by_file(pkg)
cyclocomp_by_function <- latest_cyclocomp_by_function(pkg)
last_release <- latest_release(pkg)
```

```{r}
# The open issues and the open pull requests of a package are listed the same
# way: the title links to GitHub, the rest says who opened it and when.
issue_pr_table <- function(items) {
  items |>
    mutate(
      title = paste0(
        "<a href=\"",
        url,
        "\" target=\"_blank\">",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(title),
        "</a>"
      )
    ) |>
    select(number, title, author, opened) |>
    reactable(
      columns = list(
        number = colDef(name = "#", maxWidth = 70),
        title = colDef(name = "Title", html = TRUE),
        author = colDef(name = "Opened by", maxWidth = 140),
        opened = colDef(name = "Opened", maxWidth = 110)
      ),
      defaultSorted = list(opened = "desc"),
      searchable = TRUE,
      highlight = TRUE
    )
}

```

###### Row

```{r}
series$commits |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = value, name = "Cumulative number") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Cumulative number of commits")
```


```{r}
series$lines_of_code |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = value, name = "Number of lines of code") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>

```

###### Row

```{r}
cov_by_file |>
  reactable(
    columns = list(
      file = colDef(name = "File"),
      coverage = colDef(
        name = "Coverage (%)",
        format = colFormat(digits = 1)
      ),
      lines = colDef(name = "Lines"),
      hits = colDef(name = "Hits"),
      misses = colDef(name = "Misses")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(coverage = "asc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
cyclocomp_by_function |>
  reactable(
    columns = list(
      function_name = colDef(name = "Function"),
      complexity = colDef(name = "Cyclomatic complexity")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(complexity = "desc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

###### Row

```{r}
# One point a week is plenty for a series this long, and much lighter to draw
series$cran_downloads |>
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 7)) |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = value, name = "Cumulative number") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Cumulative number of CRAN downloads")
```
